title: The New String on the Instrument
youtube_title: The New String on the Instrument | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Kavi notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a new string put on so practice would not twang wrong. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Kavi does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
